fields.name: productIDGlobalStatus
fields.description: Current status of the product. This is a rollup for the entire product including any monitored devices. The status is intended to give initiative to an SNMP monitor to get further data when this status is abnormal. The value here maps from the System Status icon on the SC GUI: grey->unknown, green->ok, yellow->noncritical, red->critical. If the productIDGlobalStatus is not ok then scLastWorstAlert contains the scAlertNbr of the alert that is responsible for the negative status.

fields.description: disk folder storage usage number (same value as scDiskFolderSUIndex)

fields.name: scDiskFolderSUTotalSpace
fields.description: Disk Folder Storage Usage total space, in GB (1,000,000,000). Replaced by scDiskFolderSUTotalSpace2.

fields.name: scDiskFolderSUUsedSpace
fields.description: Disk Folder Storage Usage used space, in GB (1,000,000,000). Replaced by scDiskFolderSUUsedSpace2

fields.name: scDiskFolderSUTotalSpace2
fields.description: Disk Folder Storage Usage total space, in GB (1,073,741,824). Matches 'Total disk space' on SC GUI.

fields.name: scDiskFolderSUUsedSpace2
fields.description: Disk Folder Storage Usage used space, in GB (1,073,741,824). Matches 'Allocated space used by volumes' on SC GUI.

fields.name: scDiskFolderSUAllocSpace
fields.description: Disk Folder Storage Usage allocated space, in GB (1,073,741,824). Matches 'Total space allocated for volume use' minus 'Unhealthy/Bad disk space' on SC GUI.

fields.name: scDiskFolderSUFreeSpace
fields.description: Disk Folder Storage Usage free space, in GB (1,073,741,824). scDiskFolderSUFreeSpace = scDiskFolderSUTotalSpace2 - scDiskFolderSUAllocSpace - scDiskFolderSUUsedSpace2. Matches 'Unallocated disk space' on SC GUI.

fields.name: scDiskFolderSUSpareSpace
fields.description: Disk Folder Storage Usage spare space, in GB (1,073,741,824). Matches 'spares available' on SC GUI.
